findings.body: The sign-off guard treats missing model and effort telemetry as proof that GPT-6 Sol at xhigh ran. `_attempt` fills `selected` only from progress lines, but this check substitutes the required values when those lines are absent. The clean Autoreview stub in `test_7_review_guards_client_signoff` emits neither line and acceptance succeeds. Require positive verification of both values so an unverified review cannot authorize sign-off.
findings.title: Not done: A strict review guards sign-off

findings.body: The review clone uses HEAD, while `records.py:272-274` validates the quote against the working-tree answers page. After `git rm --cached docs/product/BRIEF.md` and an edit, the page drops out of this index-derived `product` list. The path-limited status check at `review.py:286-287` misses it, so acceptance can quote the edited page while Autoreview saw HEAD's older page and the decision records HEAD. Check the answers page explicitly against the reviewed commit.
findings.title: Keep the quoted answers tied to the reviewed commit
